ui.title: Free tools for everyday tasks
ui.intro: Calculate image dimensions, build CSS layouts and check image color modes. Choose a tool below.
ui.local: Runs in your browser. Files and inputs are not uploaded.
ui.englishNotice: The following links open pages in English.
ui.invalid: Enter valid positive dimensions. Bleed must be zero or greater.
ui.copyError: Copy failed. Select and copy the result manually.
ui.fileError: Unable to inspect this image. Try an original JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP or GIF.
ui.colorNote: Header inspection does not validate print readiness, color accuracy or every embedded ICC profile. RGB is common for screens; ask your printer which profile to use for print.

aspect-ratio-padding-calculator.title: Aspect Ratio Padding Calculator
aspect-ratio-padding-calculator.description: Calculate the CSS padding percentage for a responsive image, video or container from its width and height. Copy a modern aspect-ratio declaration or the padding fallback.
aspect-ratio-padding-calculator.how: Enter the original width and height in the same unit. For 1920 × 1080, height divided by width times 100 gives 56.25%. The same ratio applies to 16 × 9.
aspect-ratio-padding-calculator.limits: Padding percentages are based on the containing block’s width. The modern aspect-ratio property is usually simpler. This calculator does not resize images or add actual pixels.
aspect-ratio-padding-calculator.question: Does this change the image dimensions?
aspect-ratio-padding-calculator.answer: No. It calculates CSS values only; the original image stays unchanged.

css-flexbox-generator.title: CSS Flexbox Generator
css-flexbox-generator.description: Build a CSS Flexbox layout with a live preview. Change direction, alignment, wrapping and spacing, then copy the generated container CSS.
css-flexbox-generator.how: Choose the main-axis direction, set justify-content and align-items, and adjust the gap. Increase the number of preview items to see how wrapping behaves. Paste the CSS into a stylesheet and apply the container class.
css-flexbox-generator.limits: The preview uses left-to-right CSS coordinates, even in the Arabic interface. Real content, item widths and parent styles affect wrapping. The tool generates container rules; it does not export an entire website.
css-flexbox-generator.question: Why do the option values remain in English?
css-flexbox-generator.answer: Values such as row and space-between are CSS keywords. Keep them unchanged when pasting the generated stylesheet.

rgb-cmyk-image-checker.title: RGB / CMYK Image Checker
rgb-cmyk-image-checker.description: Check whether an original JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP or GIF image uses RGB, CMYK or another color mode by inspecting its file headers in your browser.
rgb-cmyk-image-checker.how: Choose a supported image. The tool reads up to the first 128 KiB and reports the detected file format, color mode, channels, transparency and presence of an ICC profile. Your image is not uploaded.
rgb-cmyk-image-checker.limits: Unusual, truncated or large metadata may prevent detection. An unknown result is not proof of RGB. The tool does not convert colors, inspect every pixel or certify a printer’s requirements.
rgb-cmyk-image-checker.question: Does a CMYK result guarantee correct printing?
rgb-cmyk-image-checker.answer: No. A printer may require a specific ICC profile, ink limit or PDF standard. Confirm the specifications before production.

image-megapixel-calculator.title: Megapixel Calculator
image-megapixel-calculator.description: Calculate the megapixel count and total pixel count of an image from its width and height in pixels. Compare camera and export dimensions without uploading a photo.
image-megapixel-calculator.how: Enter whole-pixel dimensions. Multiply width by height for the pixel count, then divide by 1,000,000 for megapixels. A 6000 × 4000 image contains 24,000,000 pixels, or 24 MP.
image-megapixel-calculator.limits: Megapixels describe resolution, not file size or visual quality. Compression, lens quality and lighting matter. The calculation does not change the image, estimate storage or determine a suitable print DPI.
image-megapixel-calculator.question: How many pixels are in one megapixel?
image-megapixel-calculator.answer: One megapixel is 1,000,000 pixels. The displayed result is rounded, while the calculation uses the entered dimensions.

print-bleed-calculator.title: Print Bleed Calculator
print-bleed-calculator.description: Calculate the document size needed for print bleed. Add an equal bleed allowance to every edge of a finished page, card or flyer.
print-bleed-calculator.how: Choose millimeters or inches, then enter the finished width, height and bleed per edge. A 210 × 297 mm page with 3 mm bleed becomes 216 × 303 mm. Changing units converts the current values.
print-bleed-calculator.limits: Confirm the required bleed with your printer. The calculator assumes equal bleed on all four sides. It does not add crop marks, set PDF page boxes or check that artwork extends into the bleed.
print-bleed-calculator.question: Is bleed the same as a safe area?
print-bleed-calculator.answer: No. Bleed extends beyond the trim edge. A safe area keeps text and important artwork inside the trim edge.

pdf-bleed-trim-checker.title: PDF Bleed & Trim Checker
pdf-bleed-trim-checker.description: Check PDF page sizes, trim boundaries and bleed margins locally. Inspect every page and copy or download a report without uploading the file.
pdf-bleed-trim-checker.how: Choose a PDF up to 20 MiB, then select a page. Compare its physical sheet, visible area, finished cut and bleed area. The four margins show how far the bleed area extends beyond the cut.
pdf-bleed-trim-checker.limits: This checks page geometry, not the artwork. Missing explicit boxes use PDF defaults. A declared bleed area does not prove that images reach the edge. Confirm the printer’s requirements; this is not PDF/X certification.
pdf-bleed-trim-checker.question: Does this add missing bleed?
pdf-bleed-trim-checker.answer: No. The checker reads existing page boxes. It does not edit the PDF, add crop marks or extend artwork.

image-print-size-calculator.title: Image Print Size Calculator
image-print-size-calculator.description: Find how large a photo will print from its pixel dimensions and print resolution. See the result in inches and centimeters without uploading an image.
image-print-size-calculator.how: Enter whole-pixel width and height and the intended pixels per inch (PPI). A 3000 × 2400 image at 300 PPI prints at 10 × 8 inches, or 25.4 × 20.32 centimeters.
image-print-size-calculator.limits: PPI describes image pixels per printed inch; printer DPI describes ink dots. Results are rounded to three decimal places. Changing the resolution here does not resize a photo or improve its detail.
image-print-size-calculator.question: What happens if I lower the PPI?
image-print-size-calculator.answer: The same pixel dimensions produce a larger physical print, but the image may look less detailed at a close viewing distance. Ask your print provider which resolution to use.

css-gradient-generator.title: CSS Gradient Generator
css-gradient-generator.description: Create a two-color background gradient, preview its direction and copy the CSS for your website.
css-gradient-generator.how: Choose two colors and an angle from 0 to 360 degrees. At 0 degrees the gradient points upward; at 90 degrees it points right. Copy the declaration into your stylesheet.
css-gradient-generator.limits: This generates a linear gradient with two opaque colors. It does not export an image or check text contrast. Direction follows CSS coordinates, including in Arabic.
css-gradient-generator.question: Does the gradient direction change in Arabic?
css-gradient-generator.answer: No. The interface follows the selected language, but CSS angles keep their standard meaning.

css-clamp-font-generator.title: CSS Font Size Generator
css-clamp-font-generator.description: Generate responsive text sizes with CSS clamp(). Set minimum and maximum font sizes and browser widths, then copy the CSS.
css-clamp-font-generator.how: Enter increasing font sizes and increasing browser widths. The tool interpolates between the two limits. Resize the browser to see the sample text grow, then copy the generated declaration.
css-clamp-font-generator.limits: Font sizes range from 1 to 512 pixels; browser widths must be whole values from 1 to 10,000 pixels. Each maximum must exceed its minimum. Calculations assume a 16-pixel root font. The preview uses the actual browser width.
css-clamp-font-generator.question: Does changing the root font size affect this CSS?
css-clamp-font-generator.answer: Yes. The generated rem values assume 16 pixels at the root. Changing that value changes the resulting sizes and transition points.

image-scaling-calculator.title: Image Scaling Calculator
image-scaling-calculator.description: Calculate new image dimensions from a scale percentage. See the rounded pixel dimensions, scale factor and theoretical area percentage.
image-scaling-calculator.how: Enter original dimensions in whole pixels and a scale percentage. Scaling 1920 × 1080 to 50% gives 960 × 540. Both dimensions use the same factor to preserve the proportions before rounding.
image-scaling-calculator.limits: Dimensions are limited to 1,000,000 pixels per side and scaling to 0.01–10,000%. Rounded output must be at least one pixel per side. Area percentage is calculated before pixel rounding. No image is resized.
image-scaling-calculator.question: Does scaling to 50% halve the pixel area?
image-scaling-calculator.answer: No. Halving both dimensions gives one quarter of the theoretical area, or 25%. Actual whole-pixel dimensions can differ slightly because of rounding.

image-file-size-estimator.title: Image File Size Estimator
image-file-size-estimator.description: Estimate the uncompressed memory required by image pixels.
image-file-size-estimator.how: Enter pixel width, height, color channels and bits per channel.
image-file-size-estimator.limits: Pixel memory is width × height × channels × bit depth. This does not predict compressed JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF sizes.
image-file-size-estimator.question: Does this estimate the saved file size?
image-file-size-estimator.answer: No. Compression, metadata and image detail change the saved size.

photo-storage-calculator.title: Photo Storage Calculator
photo-storage-calculator.description: Estimate how many photos fit in the available storage.
photo-storage-calculator.how: Enter capacity, average photo size and the percentage reserved for system files or applications.
photo-storage-calculator.limits: This calculator uses 1 GB = 1,024 MB, following the existing binary convention. Actual sizes and filesystem overhead vary.
photo-storage-calculator.question: Is the photo count exact?
photo-storage-calculator.answer: No. It is an estimate based on the average file size you enter.

image-bandwidth-calculator.title: Image Bandwidth Calculator
image-bandwidth-calculator.description: Estimate monthly image data transfer from page views.
image-bandwidth-calculator.how: Enter average image size, images per view and monthly page views.
image-bandwidth-calculator.limits: Uses 1 MB = 1,024 KB and 1 GB = 1,024 MB. Caching, responsive images and deferred loading change actual transfer.
image-bandwidth-calculator.question: Does this include cache savings?
image-bandwidth-calculator.answer: No. It multiplies the entered image payload by page views without subtracting cached requests.

square-footage-calculator.title: Square Footage Calculator
square-footage-calculator.description: Calculate rectangular areas in square feet, square yards and square meters.
square-footage-calculator.how: Enter length and width in feet and the number of equal areas.
square-footage-calculator.limits: For irregular rooms, divide the space into rectangles and add the separate areas.
square-footage-calculator.question: Can I enter dimensions in meters?
square-footage-calculator.answer: No. Inputs are in feet; the result includes a conversion to square meters.

cubic-yard-calculator.title: Cubic Yard Calculator
cubic-yard-calculator.description: Calculate rectangular fill volume and an extra ordering allowance.
cubic-yard-calculator.how: Enter length and width in feet, depth in inches and the extra allowance percentage.
cubic-yard-calculator.limits: Compaction, settlement, excavation swell and supplier minimum quantities are not automatically included.
cubic-yard-calculator.question: Does the allowance change the net volume?
cubic-yard-calculator.answer: No. Net volume remains unchanged; the ordering volume includes the allowance.

roofing-shingle-calculator.title: Roofing Shingle Calculator
roofing-shingle-calculator.description: Estimate roofing squares and shingle bundles from roof area.
roofing-shingle-calculator.how: Enter the roof surface area in square feet, waste percentage and bundles per roofing square.
roofing-shingle-calculator.limits: One roofing square is 100 square feet. Product coverage varies. Ridge caps, starter shingles, flashing, underlayment and accessories are separate.
roofing-shingle-calculator.question: Is a roofing square one square foot?
roofing-shingle-calculator.answer: No. One roofing square covers 100 square feet.

rafter-length-calculator.title: Rafter Length Calculator
rafter-length-calculator.description: Calculate the geometric length and angle of a common roof rafter.
rafter-length-calculator.how: Enter horizontal run and overhang in feet, then rise per 12 units of run.
rafter-length-calculator.limits: Geometry only. Ridge-board deductions, birdsmouth and plumb cuts, structural sizing, trusses and code requirements are excluded.
rafter-length-calculator.question: Is this a cutting or structural specification?
rafter-length-calculator.answer: No. The geometric length needs project-specific adjustments before cutting or construction.

stud-calculator.title: Wall Stud Calculator
stud-calculator.description: Estimate studs for a straight wall with extra pieces and waste.
stud-calculator.how: Enter wall length in feet, center-to-center spacing in inches, extra studs and waste percentage.
stud-calculator.limits: Openings, corners, intersections, backing, fire blocking, headers and local framing details can require additional lumber.
stud-calculator.question: Does it design the wall structure?
stud-calculator.answer: No. It provides a simple count for planning a straight wall.

drywall-mud-calculator.title: Drywall Joint Compound Calculator
drywall-mud-calculator.description: Estimate containers of joint compound for a given board area.
drywall-mud-calculator.how: Enter area and manufacturer coverage per container in square feet, then the extra allowance.
drywall-mud-calculator.limits: Coverage depends on board arrangement, coats, corner beads, texture, taping method and product. Use your manufacturer’s coverage figure.
drywall-mud-calculator.question: Can I use one coverage rate for every product?
drywall-mud-calculator.answer: No. Enter the coverage specified for your chosen compound and application.

roof-ridge-height-calculator.title: Roof Ridge Height Calculator
roof-ridge-height-calculator.description: Calculate the ridge height of a symmetrical gable roof.
roof-ridge-height-calculator.how: Enter the full span in feet, rise per 12 units of run and wall height in feet.
roof-ridge-height-calculator.limits: Geometry only. Excludes structural sizing, ridge-board thickness, overhangs, cuts, ceiling build-up, loads and local code requirements.
roof-ridge-height-calculator.question: Is wall height included?
roof-ridge-height-calculator.answer: Yes. Total ridge height adds the entered wall height to the roof rise.

fascia-replacement-cost-calculator.title: Fascia Replacement Cost Calculator
fascia-replacement-cost-calculator.description: Estimate fascia replacement costs from the rates you enter, in US dollars.
fascia-replacement-cost-calculator.how: Enter length in feet, material and labor rates in USD per foot, waste and a removal allowance in USD.
fascia-replacement-cost-calculator.limits: No local prices are supplied. Rot, soffits, gutters, scaffolding, paint, permits, taxes, access and structural repairs are excluded unless included in your rates.
fascia-replacement-cost-calculator.question: Does choosing a language change the currency?
fascia-replacement-cost-calculator.answer: No. This calculator keeps all costs in US dollars (USD).

ppi-calculator.title: Print PPI Calculator
ppi-calculator.description: Calculate image pixels per inch at a chosen print size and check the aspect ratio.
ppi-calculator.how: Enter image dimensions in pixels and print dimensions in inches.
ppi-calculator.limits: Image PPI measures pixels per printed inch. Printer DPI measures physical ink or toner dots and is a different measurement.
ppi-calculator.question: What does a ratio mismatch mean?
ppi-calculator.answer: The image and print proportions differ by at least 0.5%; fitting may require cropping or distortion.

shed-ramp-angle-calculator.title: Shed Ramp Angle Calculator
shed-ramp-angle-calculator.description: Calculate ramp angle, slope percentage and surface length.
shed-ramp-angle-calculator.how: Enter vertical rise and horizontal run in inches.
shed-ramp-angle-calculator.limits: Geometry only. This does not check accessibility rules or building codes. Equipment clearance, traction and weather affect safe use.
shed-ramp-angle-calculator.question: Is a zero horizontal run valid?
shed-ramp-angle-calculator.answer: Yes. With a positive rise it represents a vertical surface; percentage slope is not applicable.

construction-material-waste-calculator.title: Construction Material Waste Calculator
construction-material-waste-calculator.description: Add a waste allowance and estimate material costs in US dollars.
construction-material-waste-calculator.how: Enter the net quantity, extra percentage and USD cost per matching unit.
construction-material-waste-calculator.limits: Cuts, patterns, layout and site damage change waste. Purchases may need rounding to full packs, sheets or pallets. Keep the same quantity unit throughout.
construction-material-waste-calculator.question: Are costs converted to local currency?
construction-material-waste-calculator.answer: No. Prices and cost results stay in USD.

soffit-fascia-calculator.title: Soffit & Fascia Calculator
soffit-fascia-calculator.description: Calculate soffit area, fascia board length, panel count, board quantity and waste allowance for roof eaves.
soffit-fascia-calculator.how: Enter total eave length, soffit depth, fascia board length, panel coverage and waste allowance percentage.
soffit-fascia-calculator.limits: Estimates simple rectangular eave geometries. Hip returns, gables and complex rake boards require separate field measurement.
soffit-fascia-calculator.question: Does this include panel overlaps?
soffit-fascia-calculator.answer: Use the net coverage rating of your soffit panel (sq ft per piece) and add waste allowance for cuts.

attic-insulation-payback-calculator.title: Attic Insulation Payback Calculator
attic-insulation-payback-calculator.description: Estimate attic insulation project cost, annual energy savings and simple payback period.
attic-insulation-payback-calculator.how: Enter attic area, installed cost per sq ft, annual heating/cooling expenses, expected energy savings and rebates.
attic-insulation-payback-calculator.limits: Simple-payback estimate. Actual energy savings depend on climate zone, HVAC efficiency, air leakage and utility rates.
attic-insulation-payback-calculator.question: Are tax credits and incentives included?
attic-insulation-payback-calculator.answer: Enter any local utility rebates or federal/state tax incentives in the rebates field to compute net project investment.

joist-deflection-calculator.title: Joist Deflection Calculator
joist-deflection-calculator.description: Estimate how much a floor joist or simple beam may bend under an evenly distributed load.
joist-deflection-calculator.how: Enter clear span, uniform area load, joist spacing, lumber elastic modulus, width and depth.
joist-deflection-calculator.limits: Simple beam model. Excludes shear deflection, vibration, composite subfloor action, notches and point loads.
joist-deflection-calculator.question: What is the L/360 deflection limit?
joist-deflection-calculator.answer: L/360 is the standard residential code limit for live load floor deflection to avoid plaster cracking and noticeable floor bounce.

hvac-duct-cfm-calculator.title: HVAC Duct CFM Calculator
hvac-duct-cfm-calculator.description: Estimate airflow through round or rectangular HVAC ducts from duct area and air velocity.
hvac-duct-cfm-calculator.how: Choose duct shape, enter dimensions in inches and specify air velocity in feet per minute (FPM).
hvac-duct-cfm-calculator.limits: Theoretical airflow estimate (Q = A × V). Does not size ducts based on static pressure drop, friction or duct fittings.
hvac-duct-cfm-calculator.question: What air velocity is typical for residential ducts?
hvac-duct-cfm-calculator.answer: Branch runouts typically operate around 600–800 FPM, while main distribution trunks operate around 800–1,000 FPM.

mortar-calculator.title: Mortar Calculator – Brick & Block Walls
mortar-calculator.description: Calculate mortar volume, pre-mix bags, Portland cement, and masonry sand for brick and concrete block walls.
mortar-calculator.how: Enter masonry unit count, select brick or block, joint thickness in inches, waste allowance and pre-mix bag size.
mortar-calculator.limits: Estimates standard joint bedding yields. Does not account for hollow block core grouting, deep raking or severe structural washouts.
mortar-calculator.question: What is the standard joint thickness?
mortar-calculator.answer: Standard masonry construction uses 3/8 inch (0.375 in) mortar joints between bricks and CMU blocks.

concrete-block-calculator.title: Concrete Block Calculator
concrete-block-calculator.description: Estimate CMU concrete blocks, mortar, core-fill grout, and waste allowance for block walls and foundations.
concrete-block-calculator.how: Enter wall length, wall height, openings area in sq ft, core grouting schedule and waste allowance.
concrete-block-calculator.limits: Standard 8x8x16 nominal CMU blocks (0.8889 sq ft face area). Excludes rebar schedules, bond beams and structural engineering design.
concrete-block-calculator.question: What core grouting options are supported?
concrete-block-calculator.answer: You can calculate grout requirements for cores filled every 32 inches, every 16 inches, solid-filled walls or hollow un-grouted blocks.

rainwater-harvesting-calculator.title: Rainwater Harvesting Calculator
rainwater-harvesting-calculator.description: Calculate harvestable rainwater volume from roof catchment area, annual rainfall, and roof material runoff coefficients, then size a storage tank.
rainwater-harvesting-calculator.how: Enter roof footprint, annual rainfall in inches, roofing surface material, first-flush filter loss and dry-spell storage days.
rainwater-harvesting-calculator.limits: Hydrology estimate. Excludes roof gutter overflow during extreme storms, freezing conditions and local drinking water treatment rules.
rainwater-harvesting-calculator.question: What is the first-flush filter loss?
rainwater-harvesting-calculator.answer: The first-flush diverter rejects the initial dirty roof runoff containing dust and debris, typically amounting to 5% of captured precipitation.

pdf.error: Unable to read this PDF. Choose an unencrypted, valid PDF.
pdf.tooLarge: The PDF must be no larger than 20 MiB.
pdf.note: Page geometry alone cannot confirm that artwork reaches the bleed edge.
pdf.none: Neither trim nor bleed area is explicitly declared; PDF defaults apply. This does not prove that artwork bleed is missing.
pdf.trimOnly: The trim area is declared. The bleed area uses the visible-area default; confirm whether this is acceptable to your printer.
pdf.bleedOnly: The bleed area is declared but the trim area is inherited. Confirm the intended cut boundaries.
pdf.extended: The declared bleed area extends beyond the cut on at least one edge. Check each margin and inspect the artwork separately.
pdf.zero: Both areas are declared, with no positive bleed margin beyond the cut. Check the file against your printer’s specifications.

printSize.invalid: Enter positive whole-pixel dimensions up to 1,000,000,000 and a resolution from 0.000001 to 1,000,000 PPI.

design.sample: Text grows smoothly with the browser width.
design.gradientInvalid: Choose valid colors and an angle from 0 to 360 degrees.
design.clampInvalid: Enter increasing font sizes from 1 to 512 pixels and increasing whole browser widths from 1 to 10,000 pixels.
design.scaleInvalid: Enter whole dimensions from 1 to 1,000,000 pixels and a scale from 0.01 to 10,000%. Each rounded result must be at least one pixel.

calculatorUi.invalid: Enter valid values within the indicated limits.

channels.label: Color channels
channels.help: 3 for RGB; 4 for RGBA with transparency.

bitsPerChannel.label: Bits per channel
bitsPerChannel.help: 8 for standard images; 10, 12 or 16 for greater color depth.

image-file-size-estimator.note: Pixel memory is width × height × channels × bit depth. This does not predict compressed JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF sizes.

reservedPercent.label: Reserved space (%)
reservedPercent.help: Space reserved for system files, formatting or applications.

photo-storage-calculator.note: This calculator uses 1 GB = 1,024 MB, following the existing binary convention. Actual sizes and filesystem overhead vary.

image-bandwidth-calculator.note: Uses 1 MB = 1,024 KB and 1 GB = 1,024 MB. Caching, responsive images and deferred loading change actual transfer.

square-footage-calculator.note: For irregular rooms, divide the space into rectangles and add the separate areas.

cubic-yard-calculator.note: Compaction, settlement, excavation swell and supplier minimum quantities are not automatically included.

roofing-shingle-calculator.note: One roofing square is 100 square feet. Product coverage varies. Ridge caps, starter shingles, flashing, underlayment and accessories are separate.

rafter-length-calculator.note: Geometry only. Ridge-board deductions, birdsmouth and plumb cuts, structural sizing, trusses and code requirements are excluded.

stud-calculator.note: Openings, corners, intersections, backing, fire blocking, headers and local framing details can require additional lumber.

drywall-mud-calculator.note: Coverage depends on board arrangement, coats, corner beads, texture, taping method and product. Use your manufacturer’s coverage figure.

span.label: Full roof span (feet)
span.help: Outside-to-outside horizontal span of a symmetrical gable roof.

wallHeight.label: Wall height (feet)
wallHeight.help: Reference height above the floor or ground datum.

roof-ridge-height-calculator.note: Geometry only. Excludes structural sizing, ridge-board thickness, overhangs, cuts, ceiling build-up, loads and local code requirements.

fascia-replacement-cost-calculator.note: No local prices are supplied. Rot, soffits, gutters, scaffolding, paint, permits, taxes, access and structural repairs are excluded unless included in your rates.

ppi-calculator.note: Image PPI measures pixels per printed inch. Printer DPI measures physical ink or toner dots and is a different measurement.

shed-ramp-angle-calculator.note: Geometry only. This does not check accessibility rules or building codes. Equipment clearance, traction and weather affect safe use.

netQuantity.label: Net material quantity
netQuantity.help: Use one consistent unit: area, length, pieces or other material units.

construction-material-waste-calculator.note: Cuts, patterns, layout and site damage change waste. Purchases may need rounding to full packs, sheets or pallets. Keep the same quantity unit throughout.

soffit-fascia-calculator.note: Roof geometry, gables, hip returns, and rake boards may require separate measurement. Verify manufacturer panel dimensions and field measurements before ordering.

attic-insulation-payback-calculator.note: This is a simple-payback estimator and not a building energy simulation. Actual savings depend on climate zone, current insulation level, air sealing, HVAC efficiency, and occupant habits.

uniformLoad.label: Uniform load (psf)
uniformLoad.help: Total dead + live area load (e.g. 10 psf dead + 30 psf live = 40 psf).

joist-deflection-calculator.note: Simplified engineering estimate for simply supported, uniformly loaded rectangular members. Does not evaluate shear deflection, vibration, composite action, load duration, notches, holes, or building code compliance. Consult a licensed structural engineer for safety-critical framing.

velocity.label: Air velocity (FPM)
velocity.help: Typical branch ducts run 600–800 FPM; main trunks run 800–1,000 FPM.

hvac-duct-cfm-calculator.note: Calculates theoretical airflow from cross-sectional area and air velocity (Q = A × V). Does not size ducts from static pressure, friction loss, equivalent length, fittings, or fan curves. Use ACCA Manual D for complete HVAC design.

unitCount.label: Number of masonry units (bricks or blocks)

mortar-calculator.note: Estimates mortar volume based on standard unit bedding yields (5.0 ft³ per 1,000 modular bricks; 13.5 ft³ per 100 8x8x16 CMU blocks at 3/8" joints). Site-mix estimates assume standard Type N mortar (1 bag Portland cement to 3 ft³ masonry sand). Field waste and block coring variations can alter actual consumption.

concrete-block-calculator.note: Standard 8x8x16 nominal CMU blocks cover 0.8889 ft² each (1.125 blocks per sq ft of wall). Mortar and core fill grout are calculated for standard hollow 2-cell concrete masonry units. Structural reinforcement, bond beams, and engineered rebar schedules require project engineering review.

rainwater-harvesting-calculator.note: Theoretical yield uses the standard hydrology constant (1 inch of rain on 1 sq ft = 0.6233 US gallons) multiplied by roof runoff efficiency and first-flush diversion. Tank sizing models buffer capacity for user-specified consecutive dry days. Local potable water regulations and filtration standards must be verified before drinking use.
